hypothesis: OKX USDT perpetual cross-sectional volatility-adjusted rank momentum, dollar-neutral and BTC-beta-neutral

rank_weighting.value: centered continuous ranks, inverse volatility; normalize each sign leg then constrain beta

implementation.weight_time: prior closed daily candle; next daily open execution
implementation.weighting: continuous centered percentile ranks / trailing30day volatility, dollar and BTC beta constraints
implementation.rebalance_band: excluded from raw signal precheck; no filters/stops/targets
implementation.ic_forward_returns: next open to open after horizon
implementation.ic_t_stat: Newey-West HAC with lag at least horizon-1
implementation.cost_policy: Current authenticated demo account taker fee as fixed historical scenario, explicitly not historical tier reconstruction; actual funding; historical observed per-symbol spread required for final net gate. No constant spread proxy.
implementation.missing_cost_policy: Report IC/gross and available components but leave final net gate NOT_EVALUABLE; never treat missing costs as zero.
implementation.spread_sampling_policy: If full BBO unavailable, estimate per-symbol month cost from prior-month official L2 sample: first 60 seconds of first daily archive, median positive relative spread /2; retain sample source/times/count. Never use current spreads to backfill. Coverage and sensitivity reported.

data.membership_source: causal prior-day historical OKX funding inventory including delisted instruments
data.fees: authenticated account taker metadata; not inferred from generic schedule
data.slippage: historical per-symbol observed spread, required before net precheck; no global substitute

kill_rules: Abort if any monthly admission universe has fewer than 25 symbols.
Reject family before any optimization if primary raw net Sharpe <=0.3.
Gate total costs/gross <=0.30; nonpositive gross fails.
No more than 60 configurations; no rerun on same data.

liquidity_derivation.note: 900 USDT is a sizing estimate, not a measured maximum; realized portfolio notionals must be checked separately.

authorized_rerun: User patch explicitly authorizes v2.1; original v2 remains archived; no further liquidity threshold adjustment.
